name: builder-pulse
description: Minimal lifecycle telemetry for product, feature, state, and approximate active time.

interface.shortDescription: See builder state without interrupting them.
interface.longDescription: Builder Pulse reports a claimed builder's product, explicitly labeled feature, coarse state, and capped active interval. Raw prompts, prompt lengths, commands, paths, source, and tool I/O are always off.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Builder Pulse to show the current builder state.
